root_cause: Direct Meta publishing was production-ready but could not become active without a secure first-party authorization path for Meta app credentials and Instagram OAuth.
prevention: Provide an authenticated admin-only OAuth onboarding surface instead of requiring manual long-lived runtime-token pasting.
Keep app secret and runtime access token server-side in Supabase Vault only.
Sign and expire OAuth state before callback token exchange.
Refresh long-lived Instagram tokens automatically before expiry.
Fail closed when app or runtime credentials are absent and never bypass publication authority or Mira identity gates.
